title: Bland fusion melodies and Cedar Walton's too-musical records
summary: Sam says fusion melodies repeat without thought and only Cedar Walton puts music in it, which is why it won't sell.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future
